claims.evidence: Photos show grime, oil residue, and wet/oily ground around the engine, not a clean unit.
No running, load, or start-up evidence in the photos.
No import paperwork, shipping tags, or origin markings visible in any photo.
No video/audio of the engine running; witness only saw static photos.
No odometer, hour-meter, or ECU readout shown.
No close-up of head bolts, seals, or paint-seal marks to confirm it was never disassembled.

risks.risk: Unknown internal wear (pistons, bores, bearings) and real running condition
risks.proof: Cold start video with audio showing smoke, idle, and rev behavior, plus compression test readout

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete ancillaries (turbo, injectors, sensors, wiring loom)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing turbo, injector pump, sensors, and loom intact

risks.risk: Exact DAF model/displacement unconfirmed, affecting value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID plate or block-stamped serial number
risks.if_unproven: price at lowest-value DAF variant until model confirmed

risks.proof: Photo of hour-meter/ECU mileage printout if available

risks.risk: Outdoor storage on wet/oily ground risks corrosion or water ingress
risks.proof: Close-up of intake, cylinder bores (borescope), and rust spots

risks.risk: No documentation proving import origin or legal sale history
risks.proof: Bill of lading, customs papers, or Tokunbo import certificate

proof_requests: Cold start video with sound to verify 'no knock' and running claim
Close-up of engine serial/ID plate for exact model confirmation
Photos of turbo, injectors, sensors, and wiring loom completeness
Hour-meter or ECU mileage readout if accessible
Import/customs documentation proving Belgium origin and Tokunbo status
Close-up of head bolts/seals to support 'never opened' claim
response.reason: The witness clearly identified a used DAF truck diesel engine, so it can be priced at worst-case condition given multiple unverified seller claims about testing, mileage, and origin.
